name: ocd-bees
description: Look up clients, projects, and tasks in OCDBees, then preview and confirm changes.

interface.longDescription:
OCDBees lets you work with the clients, projects, and tasks in your organization from ChatGPT.

You can ask what is Pants on Fire, what is overdue, what was completed, and what you should do next. You can search clients, projects, tasks, notes, and people.

Changes happen in two steps. ChatGPT shows a preview first, and nothing is saved until you confirm. You can create a project with tasks, add tasks, update a task, assign people, and add a note. An organization admin can also preview and confirm an import.

The connection acts as you and only sees your organization. It returns links to files, not the files themselves. An admin must turn on LLM access before you connect, and you can disconnect at any time.
interface.defaultPrompt: What can you do in my OCDBees Tenant?
